npm_dev_risk_notes: Dev-tree npm findings are out of the gate's scope (build-time toolchain only: shadcn CLI chain, browserslist/babel targets; app code has zero imports of the affected packages and they never enter the Next server/client bundles). Production-tree findings remain fully gated. Re-review this characterization whenever dev tooling dependencies change.
high_exception_notes: Single-human-owner repository: no High exception can pass until a second eligible human approver is configured, an approved exception record exists in security/exceptions.json, and this flag is flipped to true by an explicit review.
